paper.title: Analysis of Sea-Based Landing Dynamics of Reusable Landing Vehicle Considering Mechanism Flexibility
paper.journal: Transactions of Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

evidence_policy.published: Directly printed numerical value or equation.
evidence_policy.digitized: Extracted from a plotted curve and never treated as author-provided raw data.
evidence_policy.identified: Estimated from one calibration case and excluded from validation claims for that case.
evidence_policy.proxy: Engineering assumption used only in sensitivity studies.
